newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Oppenheimer starts regional brokers.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Oppenheimer starts regional brokers.

text.p: -- Oppenheimer started coverage of Morgan Keegan Inc, McDonald & Co Investments Inc and Alex. Brown Inc as buy, Legg Mason Inc and A.G. Edwards Inc as outperform and Piper Jaffray Cos as market perform, market sources said.

-- Morgan Keegan was unchanged at 13-3/4, McDonald rose 1/8 to 24, Alex. Brown added one to 62, Legg Mason was unchanged at 32-1/4, A.G. Edwards rose 3/8 to 30-1/2 and Piper Jaffray added 1/8 to 11-7/8.
